dog.description_text:
Personality & Characteristics: Veep is the sweetest and most well behaved playful puppy. He is great with my other 5-year old dog, but of course he does have lots of puppy energy! Veep is great in his crate overnight and is excellent at entertaining himself. He is very smart and doing very well with his house training. He has lots of puppy energy, but also has lots of low energy time where he just wants to snuggle up next to you. He will bark when he wants something, which is really just very funny, but doesn’t bark excessively at all.

Walking Manners: he is currently paws off so has not been outside on a walk yet!

Appetite: loooves food. Very treat motivated.

Favorite Things: he loves toys, chew treats, & snuggling!

Commands/Tricks: he is learning sit very quickly and getting very close to being fully house trained. He’s very smart and treat motivated!

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it's a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
